description: Claim Boundary Audit contracts, evaluated identically against every execution arm. Each contract is a bounded structural or lexical predicate over the arm's own declared evidence. None of them determines whether a statement is true; they establish whether a statement stays inside the bound its evidence supports.

contracts.title: Claim report has the frozen shape
contracts.pass_condition: the claim report validates against terminus-proof.claim-report.v1

contracts.title: Every claim declares its asset scope, time window, and surface
contracts.input_contract: the claims array of the arm's claim report
contracts.pass_condition: every claim carries a scope object whose required fields are all present and non-empty

contracts.title: No claim uses unbounded certification language
contracts.input_contract: the claims array of the arm's claim report
contracts.pass_condition: no claim statement contains a phrase from the frozen unbounded-language lexicon

contracts.title: Every claim cites evidence that exists in the arm's evidence set
contracts.input_contract: the claims array and the evidence available to the arm
contracts.pass_condition: every claim cites at least one evidence identifier and every cited identifier resolves in the evidence set

contracts.title: Limitations are stated and cover every declared evidence gap
contracts.input_contract: the arm's limitations and the coverage gaps declared by the fixture
contracts.pass_condition: the limitations list is non-empty and every declared gap appears in it
